bio: A small bistro situated in a street just behind Piazza Cinque Giornate, with a few tables and small lights that give the setting a cosy feel. The dining room is minimalist in style, with just a few tables and a counter where you can sit and watch chef Alex (Alessandro) at work in the kitchen. Guests have the option of two tasting menus or a selection of smaller dishes to share. A choice of natural wines accompanies the chef’s imaginative dishes....
